main_text.p: Collocatio argumentorum in fingulis exhortationum partibus.Exordia exhortationum varia.Ad collocationem vero iftarum fententia rum quod attinet, quinq; exhortatoriarũ epiftolarũ funt partes. page.notes: Greek words are transcribed from the scan and are uncertain in several places (accents and breathings in particular); the marginal headings are partly cut by the binding. Printing errors such as "ppofitio" (for propositio) and "fententia" are left as printed. Several Greek terms could not be read letter by letter and may warrant checking against the original.
